summary.text: KBH HYTTER AS is a private limited company registered in Tønsberg, founded 2012-04-10. KBH HYTTER AS is engaged in investment in real estate, trading in real estate, renovation, construction of real estate and other activities related thereto, as well as investment in shares and units. It was previously named HELMERS HUS III AS until 2022-11-10. Its main industry code is 68.110: buying and selling of own real estate. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 7 990 000 NOK and the annual result was -3 649 332 NOK; operating income was up from 0 NOK in 2023. The annual result fell from -2 637 578 NOK in 2024 to -3 649 332 NOK in 2025. Equity fell from 15 161 900 NOK in 2024 to 11 638 698 NOK in 2025. Registered leadership: Kristian Flåtnes (daglig leder) and Siri Myhre Otterlei (styrets leder), with 1 other board member.
